effect.pale.pale.desc: The foulness of the undead makes the target burn in the sun.
effect.staminafortweakers.fatigue.desc: Reduces movement speed, attack speed, and climbing speed due to exhaustion.
effect.spellbound.primed.desc: Makes the victim to explode when the duration runs out, with blast strength growing with magnitude. This will not break blocks.
effect.spellbound.tethered.desc: Draws the target towards the effect's 'anchor', typically either a projectile or an attacking entity
effect.spellbound.shielded.desc: Protects you from harm, sacrificing one level whenever you would be harmed to negate the damage. Causes Shield Recovery if only one level remains.
effect.spellbound.shields_down.desc: Will grant the target Shielded when its duration runs out.
effect.spellbound.bravados.desc: Grants absorption hearts at certain health breakpoints.
effect.spellbound.green_sparkles.desc: When activated by a successful kill, increases damage (for Rampaging weapons) or loot drops (for Despoiling weapons).
effect.spellbound.dying.desc: Causes instant death when duration runs out.
effect.rottencreatures.channelled.descri: Causes target to naturally attract lightning bolts.
effect.simplyswords.wildfire.description: An unused effect. I'm sure if it ever comes out, it'll be lit. ;)
effect.simplyswords.storm.description: An unused effect. I'm unsure WEATHER or not it'll be released. ;)
effect.simplyswords.freeze.description: Causes target to be frozen and prevents movement.
effect.simplyswords.ward.description: Grants pulsing absorption relative to remaining HP.
effect.simplyswords.immolation.descripti: Periodically inflicts damage to target and nearby foes. Outgoing damage scales with current HP.
effect.simplyswords.onslaught.descriptio: Grants pulsing haste but inflicts weakness when it expires.
effect.simplyswords.battle_fatigue.descr: Prevents dropping another Standard for a duration.
